Organizer terms subtitle: Commitments that apply to every organizer account on Event Pulse.
Organizer terms intro: By using the Event Pulse organizer space, you agree to these terms. They govern event publishing, ticket sales and participant data handling.
Organizer terms section data body: You agree to process participant personal data (name, email, phone, purchase history) solely to organize and manage your events. Reselling, sharing or unauthorized marketing use is prohibited. You must comply with applicable data protection laws.
Organizer terms section responsibility b: You are solely responsible for the accuracy of published information (date, venue, price, capacity, access rules) and for running the event. Event Pulse acts as a ticketing technology intermediary.
Organizer terms section payments body: Publication fees, commissions and payout rules are those displayed on the platform at publish time. You must maintain valid payout details when the platform requires them to receive sales proceeds.
Organizer terms section content body: Published events must be lawful, accurate and appropriate. Event Pulse may remove content or suspend accounts in case of fraud, infringement, hate speech or breach of these terms.
Organizer terms section ip body: You warrant that you hold rights to visuals, copy and brands you publish. You grant Event Pulse a non-exclusive licence to display this content when promoting your events on the platform.
Organizer terms section suspension body: Event Pulse may suspend or close an organizer account for breach of these terms, repeated disputes with participants or upon request by competent authorities.
Organizer terms section acceptance body: Acceptance is required at organizer sign-up and may be requested again after a major update. Continued use of the organizer space constitutes acceptance of the current version.
